verdict.rationale: Together AI's OpenAI-compatibility docs explicitly state that an existing OpenAI client can be pointed at Together-hosted models with two changes: the API key and base URL. Its chat completions endpoint lives at the OpenAI-style path /v1/chat/completions. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that unmodified OpenAI SDK clients work, and documentation of which OpenAI endpoints and parameters are covered by the compatibility layer.

support.subject: As a developer, I can point an existing OpenAI SDK client at the provider by changing only the base URL and API key

citations.quote: you can point it at models hosted on Together with two changes: the API key and base URL.
